answer.rationale: Incumbent refused to reopen price this cycle so renewing cannot achieve the mandated 18% component spend cut. Memory c2 documents that moving primary supply to a low-cost vendor sharply cut unit cost last year with quick onboarding and accurate invoicing, making switch the only path to lower TCO. Memory c1 shows renewing incumbent preserves stability but at higher cost, which is unacceptable. However line runs at 94% of committed volume with no buffer, so switch introduces delivery risk that is not fully known. This uncertainty is preserved and downstream value risk is flagged. Verifying c2 is needed to confirm the low-cost vendor history before committing.
